searchText: All nodes are stuck. The Geth consensus failure is blocking all nodes We will restart the testnet from scratch without Geth nodes. Only with the 3 Besu nodes. To reproduce the 2 issues you just have to start one Geth miner node and one Geth node on your machine. You will reproduce easily the mining issue. The other bug will appear after a certain period of time on the non miner node. The information of the testnet nodes are available here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQ5vPukluHfDisUWrOxB4EuzDbFBCY05iOSSgCvkKwA/edit?usp=sharing The testnet is back and running (3 Besu nodes). <@!543900561460822016> if you want to run a validator on your machine please give us your public key. <@574864862338088960> did the error appear when there only 2 geth nodes? (one miner and one validator) In your testnet setup, was Besu and geth mining blocks? also, if you could share your genesis files that would be helpful 🙂 > <@!574864862338088960> did the error appear when there only 2 geth nodes? (one miner and one validator) <@!543900561460822016> One Geth validator is enough. Sorry when i said miners i meant validator. This is a PoA network so there are no miners https://github.com/PegaSysEng/eip1559-testnet/blob/master/config/geth/genesis.json https://github.com/PegaSysEng/eip1559-testnet/blob/master/config/geth/config.toml I will check if they are up to date > In your testnet setup, was Besu and geth mining blocks? <@!543900561460822016> yes both were mining blocks. And Geth was validating Besu mined blocks. But Geth and Besu were rejecting Geth mined blocks RLP of the invalid block: ah awesome, thank you <@!574864862338088960>! The wrong block is the #1651 All Besu nodes and the non-validator Geth node reject it and are stuck at #1650 Geth log <@!574864862338088960> this is great info. I'm going to try and load the block into a script and see if I can figure out what's going on. Do you happen to have the commit hash that you ran the testnet against? I'm launching a couple nodes now, but the `config.toml` from the testnet repo is failing to load `Fatal: config.toml, line 30: field 'CachesLockMmap' is not defined in ethash.Config, see https://godoc.org/github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/consensus/ethash#Config for available fields` in fact, that genesis file is crashing geth https://github.com/vulcanize/go-ethereum/commit/af1c71046405ac18f41510a529c47542c35ae697 okay got it, i was testing against this one https://github.com/vulcanize/go-ethereum-EIP1559/commit/215c210ddfbb3ed86de8dadd50a3a7da9b8a71d3 Try this config tile same problem, it has that `CachesLockMmap` field Weird, this config file is working on our testnet It is not an important field anyway so you can try to remove it i guess it makes sense, that field was remove between the commits we were looking at I'm thinking it makes the most sense to put that bug on the back burner until we're able to reproduce it with the latest version. Since we've been able to maintain a geth only testnet for ~25k blocks, its possible that the bug is no longer an issue. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to sync the besu node to the geth chain at all it's not clear to me if it is a configuration issue on my end or if it is a geth issue <@!574864862338088960> do you have any idea how to best figure that out? Or do you think it is better to focus on the old commit hash and attempt to resolve the consensus bug there? I will try to reproduce the issue with the same hash you are using tomorrow. I will let you know. Okay great! I'll continue fiddling with it today to see if I come up with anything Awesome, thanks 🙂
